name: Ogive
description: The ogive: a pointed arch outlined, standing or inverted as the row alternates.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 240; r: 1 - 0.45 * cos(t); rotate: -90; scale: 0.66; frame: 12); clip-path: @shape(points: 240; r: 1 - 0.45 * cos(t); rotate: -90; scale: 0.66; frame: 12); @match(@y % 2 == 1) { -webkit-transform: rotate(180deg); transform: rotate(180deg); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
